purpose: Your goals and how much is left for each one.
see: Each goal with its progress bar. · What's saved and what's left. · The target date, if you set one.
do: Create a goal. · Add a contribution. · Change the goal or the date. · Archive a goal you've reached.

faq.q: Does a contribution come out of my account?
faq.a: Only if you record it from an account. Otherwise, it's just recorded as progress on the goal.
Yes, if you have a household. Choose the household when you create it.
